leads.location: Istanbul, notably Mecidiyekoy and approaches to Taksim Square
leads.description: May Day demonstrators and union members tried to march toward Taksim despite restrictions. AP reports water cannons/pepper spray and over 500 detentions; by 6 p.m. the Istanbul governor's office said 575 had been detained. The official rationale was public safety; authorities blamed 'marginal groups' for clashes.

sources.provenance: Opened AP story and captions document date, locations, march attempt, police response and official arrest count. AP summary says over 500; governor's office said 575 by 6pm.
sources.excerpt: Turkish authorities detained over 500 May Day demonstrators on Friday

leads.count_variants: AP reports over 500 detained; the Istanbul governor's office said 575 by 6 p.m. This is a reported official count, not a crowd estimate.

leads.event_date_confidence: high; Agos states march occurred June 21
leads.description: The 12th Istanbul Trans Pride march took place despite district bans; ten people were detained and released that evening, according to Agos.

leads.description: The 24th Istanbul Pride march occurred despite bans. HRFT reports police intervention and 65 detentions, including four journalists, released after questioning on June 29. Bianet documents bans in Kadıköy/Beyoğlu and road/transit restrictions; authorities cited public order and safety grounds.
